data.body:
[P2] Establish evidence for the invocation-retry assumption

The PR's Assumptions section justifies Lambda retrying from the last checkpoint only by saying the existing SDK behaves this way. The reported fake-client and local-runner tests do not establish that service behavior, and the assumption is not marked "unverified." This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 6 and leaves the late async-checkpoint failure guarantee without the required evidence. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6): cite the applicable service contract or a real failure/replay test, or explicitly mark the assumption unverified for maintainer assessment.
